text: Two planting methods are used: (1) direct seeding — pre-soak seed in warm water for 1-2 hours, treat with a fungicide/insecticide seed-coating product (e.g. Cruiser Plus 312.5FS: Thiamethoxam 262.5g/L + Difenoconazole 25g/L + Fludioxonil 25g/L, ~10ml per 2 liters water or 2ml per kg seed, soaked ~2-3 hours before sowing), then sow 1 seed per hole 25-50cm apart depending on variety/season; or (2) nursery-raised seedlings — germinate in trays/pots, harden off in the sun for 2-5 days, then transplant at 7-10 days old once 2-4 true leaves have formed, transplanting in late afternoon or under cloud cover to reduce shock.
